exposure: v1 outcomes seen; new confirmation outcomes not scored
mechanism: Cost ordering flips: base TICOtest EN77.57 FR76.68; Books EN61.55 FR50.99. Raw-total development parity can overallocate merges to French and transfer poorly. Causality not established.
candidate: Domain-normalized worst-domain selection: for each 2-language development domain compute cost/within-domain mean. Pick largest entry, select that language, then use native highest-frequency TRAIN pair. Equal N per domain.
math: For 2 language positive costs, max relative cost = 1+2Gini, hence selects currently worst-Gini domain. Does NOT guarantee next pair decreases worst Gini or costs in all domains.
control: Native base on pooled identical 100 TICO+100 Books dev rows; same information and dev budget as candidate. Original base uses200TICO.

new_data.limitations: Books paragraph rows may remain in same novel; no whole-book/domain population inference; translation variation and contextual dependence remain.

prediction: Candidate may reduce max Gini across the two confirmation domains compared with matched pooled control. Cannot call improvement if only compared with mismatched-information original base.
decision_rule: Support local candidate only if max-domain Gini lower than pooled, while reporting each domain, total and worst-language costs; otherwise retain negative. No outcome-based tuning in this version.
